Class SpazioAperto

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.AdventureCard
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.SpazioAperto
public class SpazioAperto extends AdventureCard
A class representing the SpazioAperto adventure card. Provides specific mechanics for processing the card's actions, decision-making, and effects within the game.

    • checkRequirements

      public void checkRequirements()
      Checks whether the current player's ship meets the requirements to activate double motors. If sufficient batteries and double motors are available, allows the player to decide their usage. Otherwise, processes travel days as a fallback.
      Overrides:
      checkRequirements in class AdventureCard

    • applyEffect

      public void applyEffect()
      Applies the effect specific to the SpazioAperto adventure card. This implementation calculates the travel days earned based on the power of activated motors and deactivates the relevant components of the ship. Calls the superclass applyEffect method to ensure proper state handling.
      Overrides:
      applyEffect in class AdventureCard
